user.title: SOLARMAN OpenAPI
user.description: The APP ID and APP Secret are not generated in the app: request them from SOLARMAN support (https://helpcenter.solarmanpv.com), asking for OpenAPI access for your account. Also enter your account e-mail and password and the logger SN. If automatic inverter discovery does not work, enter the inverter SNs manually (comma separated).

data_description.app_secret: Provided by SOLARMAN support. Keep it private.
data_description.logger_sn: Serial number of the data logger that groups the inverters.
data_description.inverter_sns: Only needed if automatic discovery does not find the inverters.

shares.title: Generation share
shares.description: Enter the percentage of each inverter's generation that is yours. The "with share" sensors sum value × percentage over the inverters.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the API
error.no_inverters: No inverters found. Enter the SNs manually.
error.no_data: The API returned no data for one of the inverters (check the SN)

init.title: Options
init.description: The optional data keys choose which data point feeds the "with share" sensors; empty means auto-detect.
